newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African industrials drift weaker, golds end up.
newsitem.headline: S.African industrials drift weaker, golds end up.

text.p: A blend of profit-taking after bargain-hunting last week and futures-related dealings pushed industrial stocks gradually weaker on Tuesday to end near the day's lowest levels.
Dealers said concerns about possible inflationary pressures in the U.S. and the effect of this on the Dow also weighed on shares.
Gold stocks edged higher, losing some of their lustre towards the finish, as bullion juggled with the $349 level.
The 100 percent industrial index ended down 40.9 points at 8,244.7, the gold index added 9.8 points to 1,327.8 and the overall index fell 30.6 to 7,044.1.
Volumes were moderate with dealers saying the day's turnover of around 700 million rand was deceptive as it was boosted by a few large deals.
Traders said the market would once again eye Wall Street on Tuesday for direction.
